Genesis 1:1.title: Genesis 1:1
Genesis 1:1.content: In the beginning—a period of remote and unknown antiquity, hid in the depths of eternal ages; and so the phrase is used in Proverbs 8:22, 23.

John 3:16.title: John 3:16
John 3:16.content: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son—Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us.

Romans 8:1.title: Romans 8:1
Romans 8:1.content: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus—As Christ, who knew no sin, was made sin for us, so we, who had no righteousness of our own, are made the righteousness of God in Him.
